mapper.insert: INSERT INTO following (id, from_user_id, to_user_id, rel_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{relStatus}, NOW(3), NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rel_status = 1, updated_at = NOW(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE following SET rel_status = 0, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE from_user_id = #{fromUserId} AND to_user_id = #{toUserId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM following WHERE from_user_id = #{fromUserId} AND to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND rel_status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follower (id, to_user_id, from_user_id, rel_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{toUserId}, #{fromUserId}, #{relStatus}, NOW(3), NOW(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE follower SET rel_status = 0, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND from_user_id = #{fromUserId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.* FROM following f JOIN users u ON f.to_user_id = u.id WHERE f.from_user_id = #{userId} AND f.rel_status = 1 ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
